combatant_info.background_text:
Kyrken's Apostle who wanders the universe of her own accord.
Chosen as Kyrken's Apostle, a wanderer who drifts through the cosmos. Those who saw her drifting through space without even a ship, unable to comprehend what they had witnessed, came to call her an "Ill Omen." Despite being an Apostle, she shows no sign of sincerely serving Kyrken, merely carrying out the occasional decree or command she receives.

combatant_limit_breaks.desc:
Adds the following effect to the Kyrken’s Apostle card: Gain 1 AP.
Changes the following effects for the Kyrken’s Aegis effect: Increase Damage Amount of Attack Cards of this unit by 30%, and increase final Damage Amount of Flicker Blade by 20%
combatant_limit_breaks.title: Sleeping Memory

combatant_limit_breaks.desc:
At the start of battle, increase Rossweisse’s final Damage Amount by 20%.
At the start of the turn, gain 4 Blade Afterimage.
Blade Afterimage: When Rossweisse’s Light or Dark cards are activated, 120% Damage to a random enemy, create 1 Sword Tassel, then decrease Blade Afterimage by 1 (max 8 stacks)
combatant_limit_breaks.title: Awakening Memory

combatant_limit_breaks.title: Vivid Memory

combatant_limit_breaks.desc:
At the start of battle, gain 1 Precious Name.
Each time the effect of Rossweisse’s Light or Dark cards activate, gain 1 Precious Name.
Precious Name: Increase Rossweisse’s Damage Amount by 8% (max 5 stacks)

<#DAA520>「Sig, Siegrune, Gerhilde, Fricka... and you.」

combatant_limit_breaks.title: Complete Memory

combatant_limit_breaks.desc:
